messages:
Priya: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp (Node) is dropping the x-request-id on a retry. First request logs show the header, retry does not. Anyone run into this?
Sam: Saw something similar last week. Is this the devx quickstart sample or a customer app?
Priya: devx quickstart/sampleapp (Node 18, express). Using pino + our loghook. REDWOOD_OTEL=1 in env.
Alex: Likely ordering of OTEL init vs logger init. If the logger is created before the OTEL context propagation is set up, the hook won't pick up trace or request headers on subsequent attempts.
Priya: How do we repro quickly?
Alex: Start server, curl with header: `curl -H "x-request-id:0001" http://localhost:3000/api` then trigger a 502 path that our retry library follows. Or simpler: move OTEL start to the top of server.js before any logger requires.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-47 - sampleapp missing request header after retry (assigned devex)
Emily: Another angle: some HTTP clients (axios by default) don’t persist custom headers on retries/follow-ups unless configured. If sampleapp uses axios/axios-retry, ensure headers are preserved in the retry callback.
Josh: Minimal local fix I used: 
```
// server.js
require('@opentelemetry/sdk-node').start()
const logger = require('./logger')
const express = require('express')
const app = express()
// ensure otel middleware runs before logger middleware
app.use(otelMiddleware)
app.use(loggerMiddleware)
```
Also add: `res.locals.requestId = req.headers['x-request-id'] || generateId()` so pino hook has a stable source.
Priya: Trying that now. If it fixes, we should update the quickstart and sampleapp.
Sam: We also have a small test harness template: `curl -H "x-request-id:123" /ping && grep 123 logs/output.log` — probably worth adding to CI for sampleapp.
Priya: Patch opened: https://git.internal/redwood/devex/sampleapp/pull/428 - moves OTEL start, copies header into res.locals, updates README with note about client retries.
Alex: Nice. I'll add a checklist item to onboarding: "start OTEL before logger and verify header passthrough across retries".
Josh: One more defensive improvement: update our loghook to fallback to OTEL trace id if no x-request-id present. Snippet: `const traceId = trace.getSpan(context.active())?.spanContext()?.traceId` and include that in logs when requestId missing.
Priya: Good call — I'll add that fallback to the PR.
notes: thread captures a short debugging convo about logging header loss across retries and quick fixes for the sampleapp. PR created and incident tracked.
